LESSON: WRITING 12.4.1 GUIDED COMPOSITION

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.4: Writing 12.4.1 Guided Composition

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 12.4.1 Guided Composition. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should we keep a record of what we do?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the components of a diary for effective writing
2. write a diary in the right format for effective communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WRITING 12.4.1 GUIDED COMPOSITION
This lesson teaches Writing 12.4.1 Guided Composition for Grade 4 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the components of a diary for effective writing
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. write a diary in the right format for effective communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Writing 12.4.1 Guided Composition using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Writing 12.4.1 Guided Composition above.
2. Explain Writing 12.4.1 Guided Composition to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Writing 12.4.1 Guided Composition.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 12.4.1 Guided Composition with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Writing 12.4.1 Guided Composition important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should we keep a record of what we do?
2. What information do we record?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the components of a diary for effective writing
2. write a diary in the right format for effective communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
